# VTube Studio triggers

## Any VTube Studio message (advanced)

Runs for any message VTube Studio sends, so you can react to things Cuebot has no special trigger for. For advanced users.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **API event names** | Only react to these kinds of VTube Studio messages, like "ModelMovedEvent". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for all. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%eventName%` | The kind of VTube Studio message |
| `%data%` | All the details of the message, as raw text |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.event`</small>

## Background changed

Runs when you switch the background in VTube Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Background names** | Only react to these backgrounds, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any background. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%backgroundName%` | The name of the new background |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.backgroundChanged`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to VTube Studio.

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to VTube Studio, for example when you close it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.disconnected`</small>

## Expression toggled

Runs when an expression (a face or pose preset) is switched on or off in VTube Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Expression names** | Only react to these expressions, typed by name or file. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any expression. |
| **State** | Pick On to react when it turns on, Off when it turns off, or Any for both. Options: Either way, Turned on, Turned off. Starts as: `Either way`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%modelName%` | The name of the model |
| `%modelId%` | VTube Studio's id for the model |
| `%expressionName%` | The name of the expression |
| `%expressionFile%` | The expression's file |
| `%active%` | True when the expression is now on |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.expressionToggled`</small>

## Face tracking found

Runs when VTube Studio sees your face again after losing it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%faceFound%` | True if a face is being tracked |
| `%leftHandFound%` | True if the left hand is tracked |
| `%rightHandFound%` | True if the right hand is tracked |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.trackingFound`</small>

## Face tracking lost

Runs when VTube Studio can no longer see your face. Good for a "brb" reaction.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%faceFound%` | True if a face is being tracked |
| `%leftHandFound%` | True if the left hand is tracked |
| `%rightHandFound%` | True if the right hand is tracked |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.trackingLost`</small>

## Hotkey triggered

Runs when a VTube Studio hotkey is used, for example to change an expression or play an animation.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Hotkey names** | Only react to these hotkeys, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any hotkey. |
| **Hotkey action** | Only react to this kind of hotkey, like "ToggleExpression" or "TriggerAnimation". Leave empty for any kind. |
| **Ignore hotkeys triggered by plugins** | Tick to ignore hotkeys that other programs (including Cuebot) triggered, so only hotkeys you press yourself count. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%hotkeyName%` | The name of the hotkey |
| `%hotkeyId%` | The hotkey's id |
| `%hotkeyAction%` | What the hotkey does |
| `%hotkeyFile%` | The file the hotkey uses, if any |
| `%triggeredByApi%` | True if another program triggered it |
| `%modelName%` | The model it was used on |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.hotkeyTriggered`</small>

## Item added

Runs when an item (a prop or picture) is added to your VTube Studio scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item files** | Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%itemEventType%` | What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on |
| `%itemInstanceId%` | The id of this copy of the item |
| `%itemFileName%` | The item's file name |
| `%itemX%` | Where the item is, left to right |
| `%itemY%` | Where the item is, bottom to top |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.itemAdded`</small>

## Item event

Runs when something happens to an item (a prop or picture in your VTube Studio scene), like being added, removed or clicked.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item event** | Which kind of thing to react to. Pick Any to react to all of them. Options: Any, Added, Removed, DroppedPinned, DroppedUnpinned, Clicked, Locked, Unlocked. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Item files** | Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%itemEventType%` | What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on |
| `%itemInstanceId%` | The id of this copy of the item |
| `%itemFileName%` | The item's file name |
| `%itemX%` | Where the item is, left to right |
| `%itemY%` | Where the item is, bottom to top |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.itemEvent`</small>

## Item removed

Runs when an item (a prop or picture) is removed from your VTube Studio scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item files** | Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%itemEventType%` | What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on |
| `%itemInstanceId%` | The id of this copy of the item |
| `%itemFileName%` | The item's file name |
| `%itemX%` | Where the item is, left to right |
| `%itemY%` | Where the item is, bottom to top |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.itemRemoved`</small>

## Model animation

Runs when an animation on the model starts, ends or sends a custom signal.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Animation event** | Start reacts when an animation begins, End when it finishes, Custom for special signals set inside the animation, Any for all. Options: Any, Start, End, Custom. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Animation names** | Only react to these animations, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any animation. |
| **Ignore idle animations** | Tick to ignore the animations the model plays by itself while doing nothing (idle animations). Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%modelName%` | The name of the model |
| `%modelId%` | VTube Studio's id for the model |
| `%animationEventType%` | Start, End or Custom |
| `%animationName%` | The name of the animation |
| `%animationLength%` | How long the animation lasts, in seconds |
| `%animationEventData%` | Extra text for custom signals |
| `%isIdleAnimation%` | True if it is an idle animation |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.modelAnimation`</small>

## Model clicked

Runs when someone clicks in the VTube Studio window, for example on your model.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Mouse button** | Only react to this mouse button, or pick Any. Options: Any, Left, Right, Middle. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Only clicks on the model** | Tick to only react when the click lands on the model. Untick to react to clicks anywhere. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%modelName%` | The name of the model |
| `%modelId%` | VTube Studio's id for the model |
| `%modelWasClicked%` | True if the click hit the model |
| `%mouseButton%` | Left, Right or Middle |
| `%clickX%` | Where the click landed, sideways |
| `%clickY%` | Where the click landed, up or down |
| `%clickedArtMeshCount%` | How many parts of the model were hit |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.modelClicked`</small>

## Model configuration changed

Runs when the settings of the loaded model change in VTube Studio, for example when you edit its hotkeys.

| --- | --- |
| `%modelName%` | The name of the model |
| `%modelId%` | VTube Studio's id for the model |
| `%hotkeyConfigChanged%` | True if the hotkey list changed |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.modelConfigChanged`</small>

## Model moved

Runs when the model is moved, turned or resized in VTube Studio.

**Variables you get**

| `%modelName%` | The name of the model |
| `%modelId%` | VTube Studio's id for the model |
